title: Verification invariant catalog
description: Draft. Project-agnostic catalog of named correctness properties. Generated from verify-core types once M1 lands; hand-written here as a design draft.

namespace.description: Identifier prefix, e.g. LABBY, DRIVE, CORE. The tooling does not interpret its meaning, but verify-core enforces that every invariant id begins with this namespace followed by '-'. JSON Schema cannot express that cross-field dependency, so it is a catalog-validation rule, not a convention.

id.description: Globally unique and permanently stable. Retirement never frees an id. The prefix before the first '-' must equal the catalog's `namespace`; enforced by verify-core, not by this schema.

model.description: Target model name; resolved against the project's target registry.

checks.description: Backend handles, not file paths. Keys are backend ids; the set is intentionally open so that adding a backend does not require an L1 schema bump (which would break extraction gate 3 in SPEC §14). An unknown backend id is rejected by verify-core against the registered backend set, where the error can name the available ids. An unresolved handle is a hard error, never silent uncovered status. An absent backend key means this invariant is not claimed by that backend.
